chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: Best bands he worked in and the honour of being in Basie's band
summary: He names Speed Webb and Thamon Hayes among the best bands and says he was honored to be in Basie's band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: You mentioned the Speed Webb band as one of the best...
What other bands would you say were particularly good?
The Thamon Hayes band. That was a good band. Let's see... Well, most all those bands I played with were good bands, you know.
Probably the one that became most famous. During the time you were in it, it had sort of become a legendary band.
Do you feel that that was one of the high points, up to then, in your playing career, being in that band? Or was it just...
Well, I felt very honored to be in that band. Yes... And I did have a ball while I was in there,
